name: FreePats 手风琴 bounded-range
sampled_range: D3-A#5 playable; D3-G5 core plus a bounded G#5-A#5 extension
sampled_range_note: MIDI 80-82 is transposed upward by at most 3 semitones from the highest real attack root G5 (MIDI 79). MIDI 83-91 from the former 12-semitone extension is intentionally rejected.
modeling_rationale: The source has real attack roots MIDI 47-79. Runtime MIDI 50-79 is the core range; MIDI 80-82 is a bounded extension from root 79 with at most +3 semitones, matching the largest upward stretch already used inside the core. MIDI 83-91 is rejected because no admissible higher-root source with equally clear licensing and sustain/release structure was found.
